name: mail-api-retired-next-year
description: A partner will retire the old version of its booking API next September, with months of notice: worth knowing, nothing is urgent, so it is kept for the digest.
recordedBy: written for the held-out set before any run (Story 0.26)

item.subject: Version 1 of the booking API retires next September
item.text: Hello, version 1 of our booking API will be retired next September. Version 2 has been available since this spring, and we will send a migration guide in the coming months. Nothing changes before then. Thanks, Carrier Partner Support
